dish.title: Greek Fasolakia: Green Beans and Potatoes Braised in Tomato and Olive Oil

recipe_version.title: Greek Fasolakia: Green Beans and Potatoes Braised in Tomato and Olive Oil
recipe_version.description: Green beans and Yukon Gold potatoes braised slowly with onion, garlic, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, and plenty of olive oil until silky, finished with oregano, parsley, and dill.

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Trim the beans, cut the potatoes into 1 1/2-inch chunks, chop the onion, and slice the garlic.

steps.title: Sweat
steps.body: Heat the olive oil in the 5.5-quart Dutch oven over medium, about 2 minutes. Cook the onion until soft, about 6 minutes, then the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.

steps.title: Braise
steps.body: Add the beans, potatoes, crushed tomatoes, 1 cup water, oregano, salt, and pepper and stir. Bring to a simmer, about 6 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and braise, stirring twice, until the beans are very soft, about 40 minutes; chop the parsley and dill meanwhile. Uncover and simmer 5 minutes to thicken.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Stir in the parsley and most of the dill and let it stand off the heat for 5 minutes. Serve warm in bowls with the rest of the dill.
